subject.title: feat(plugins): add exact-profile provider usage reads

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose exact-profile provider-usage reads to trusted plugins through `PluginRuntime`, or should this remain provider-owned/internal until a broader plugin capability contract is approved?
rationale: The patch changes the public plugin runtime and SDK surface; tests can validate mechanics but cannot decide whether this is the supported permanent capability boundary or its desired long-term contract.

options.title: Approve the focused runtime API
options.body: Keep the token-free exact-profile API, provided redacted real-provider proof and final compatibility review confirm the documented behavior.

options.title: Keep usage reads provider-owned for now
options.body: Do not add the shared runtime API until maintainers define a broader provider-usage capability and permission model.

recommendation.title: Approve the focused runtime API
recommendation.body: Keep the token-free exact-profile API, provided redacted real-provider proof and final compatibility review confirm the documented behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main feature-history owner for the plugin-runtime and provider-usage boundary could not be verified from the supplied review evidence.
